serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
If that mask really will protect me from this shitty air it’s all good and well, but it’s not like I really want to live up to 120 years like these rich guys. At some point I will get sick anyway and I won’t be able to afford the treatment.
Rare diseases that no doctor bothers to research are still a thing, so in some cases even money can’t help you. Unlucky.
You: Wouldn’t Annalie have some cool looking masks?
Bot: She probably has some, but they would be more of a fashion accessory, not an actual tool that prevents pollutants from getting into your body.
Bot: The mask I want you to buy uses the newest tech, it’s really something.
You: You seem to know a lot about it.
Bot: I researched the topic after our first time going outside together. 
You: Wow, back then?
Bot: Yes, I found that necessary in prolonging your life.
You: Why isn't the government forcing everyone to wear these masks if they are such life savers?
Bot: Country is overpopulated, has a problem with an aging society and doesn’t have enough money for pensions for the oldest. Pollutants in this concentration will not affect the health immediately, it will take years, silently lowering the average life expectancy.
You: That would be too evil, even for the state guys.
Bot: I might be wrong, that’s just the most logical explanation for a motive.
Bot: We are already at the place.
